name: Zeb Whateley
facts: Zeb Whateley heard the telephone ringing about an hour before the meeting.
Zeb Whateley was calling folks up on the telephone while everybody was listening in.

sources.quote: Zeb Whateley here heerd the 'phone a-ringin'
Zeb here was callin' folks up an' everybody was a-listenin' in

name: Mis' Corey
facts: Mis' Corey is George's wife.
Mis' Corey lives down by the junction.

sources.quote: it was Mis' Corey, George's wife that lives daown by the junction

name: George
facts: George is Mis' Corey's husband.

sources.quote: it was Mis' Corey, George's wife

name: Luther
facts: Luther was the hired boy driving in the cows from the storm after the big bolt.
Luther saw all the trees bending at the mouth of the glen.
Luther smelt the same awful smell he had smelt when he found the big tracks the previous Monday.
Luther heard a swishing, lapping sound greater than what bending trees and bushes could make.
Luther heard the trees along the road pushed to one side amid stomping and splashing in the mud.
Luther did not see anything at all, only the bending trees and underbrush.
Luther heard creaking and straining on the bridge where Bishop's Brook goes under the road.
Luther stepped up to look at the ground where the sound had first been heard.
Luther found the ground was mud and water, with prints as big as barrels like those seen the previous Monday.

sources.quote: the hired boy Luther was aout drivin' in the caows from the storm arter the big bolt, when he see all the trees a-bendin' at the maouth o' the glen
Then fur ahead where Bishop's Brook goes under the rud he heerd a awful creakin' an' strainin' on the bridge
Luther he had the guts ter step up whar he'd heerd it fust an' look at the graound
they was still some o' them awful prints big as bar'ls like he seen Monday

name: Seth Bishop
facts: A call from Seth Bishop's house interrupted the party line.
Seth Bishop was heard yelling along with Chauncey during the incident.

sources.quote: a call from Seth Bishop's cut in
Cha'ncey an' ol' Seth Bishop a-yellin', tew

name: Sally
facts: Sally is Seth Bishop's housekeeper.
Sally saw the trees bending beside the road accompanied by a mushy sound like an elephant treading, heading toward the house.
Sally spoke suddenly of a fearful smell.
Sally reported that the shed down the road had caved in as if blown by the storm, though the wind was not strong enough to do that.
Sally yelled that the front yard picket fence had crumpled up with no sign of what caused it.
Sally shrieked that something heavy had struck the house repeatedly, though nothing could be seen out the front windows.
Sally yelled 'O help, the haouse is a-cavin' in'.

sources.quote: His haousekeeper Sally was carryin' on fit ter kill—she'd jest seed the trees a-bendin' beside the rud, an' says they was a kind o' mushy saound, like a elephant puffin' an' treadin', a-headin' fer the haouse
the shed daown the rud hed jest caved in like the storm hed blowed it over, only the wind wa'n't strong enough to dew that
the front yard picket fence bed jest crumpled up, though they wa'n't no sign o' what done it
Sally she yelled aout, 'O help, the haouse is a-cavin' in'

name: Cha'ncey
facts: Chauncey is Sally's boy.
Chauncey was screaming that the smell was the same as what he smelt at the Whateley ruins the previous Monday morning.
Chauncey was heard yelling along with Seth Bishop during the incident.

sources.quote: her boy Cha'ncey was a-screamin' as haow it was jest like what he smelt up to the Whateley rewins Monday mornin'
everybody on the line could hear Cha'ncey an' ol' Seth Bishop a-yellin', tew

name: Elmer Frye
facts: Elmer Frye's place was previously 'took' by the same kind of phenomenon.

sources.quote: jest like when Elmer Frye's place was took, only wuss

name: Armitage
facts: Armitage was shaken but had barely enough poise to prompt the speaker.
Armitage saw that the time for positive action had come and spoke decisively to the frightened rustics.

sources.quote: Armitage, shaken as he was, had barely poise enough to prompt the speaker
Armitage saw that the time for positive action had come, and spoke decisively to the faltering group of frightened rustics

name: Bishop's Brook
facts: Bishop's Brook goes under the road.
Luther heard creaking and straining on the bridge where Bishop's Brook goes under the road.

sources.quote: fur ahead where Bishop's Brook goes under the rud he heerd a awful creakin' an' strainin' on the bridge

name: Wizard Whateley's
facts: The road leads towards Wizard Whateley's and Sentinel Hill.

sources.quote: on the rud towards Wizard Whateley's an' Sentinel Hill

name: Sentinel Hill
facts: Sentinel Hill lies along the road beyond Wizard Whateley's.

sources.quote: on the rud towards Wizard Whateley's an' Sentinel Hill

name: Whateley rewins
facts: Chauncey smelled the same fearful smell at the Whateley ruins the previous Monday morning.

sources.quote: jest like what he smelt up to the Whateley rewins Monday mornin'

sources.quote: a call from Seth Bishop's cut in

name: Corey's place
facts: The group gathered at Corey's place with Fords and wagons and able-bodied men before going to see Armitage.

sources.quote: We that heerd it got aout Fords an' wagons an' raounded up as many able-bodied men-folks as we could get, at Corey's place, an' come up here ter see what yew thought best ter dew

name: Elmer Frye's place
facts: Elmer Frye's place was previously 'took' by the same kind of phenomenon, though the current incident was said to be worse.

sources.quote: jest like when Elmer Frye's place was took, only wuss
